# Where TNDS and the DfT's BODS GTFS disagree, stop by stop

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE,
                      fig.path = "figures/stopgap-", dpi = 110,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

# The case figures are numbered by position, and which stops are cases changes
# whenever the data does. Clear the previous run's figures so that a shorter
# case list does not leave stale images beside the report.
unlink(Sys.glob("figures/stopgap-*"))

g <- readRDS(gap_path)
s <- as.data.table(g$stops)
win <- g$window
day <- g$day
wl <- as.integer(win$enddate - win$startdate) + 1L
tol_min <- g$tol / 60

has_map <- exists("map_zones_path") && !is.null(map_zones_path) &&
  file.exists(map_zones_path)
has_patchwork <- requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)

fmt <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE,
                          trim = TRUE)
pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x), "—")
dfmt <- function(d) ifelse(is.na(d), "—", format(as.Date(d), "%a %e %b"))
cn <- c(E = "England", W = "Wales", S = "Scotland")

periods <- c(win = sprintf("%d-day window", wl),
             day = format(day, "single day (%A %e %B %Y)"))
periods_short <- c(win = "window", day = "day")
types <- c("TNDS only", "BODS only", "TNDS higher", "BODS higher")
type_lv <- c(types, "equal")
type_cols <- c("TNDS only" = "#164a8c", "TNDS higher" = "#7fa9e0",
               "BODS higher" = "#e88aa0", "BODS only" = "#8f2340",
               "equal" = "#bdbdbd")
src_cols <- c(TNDS = "#2a78d6", `BODS GTFS` = "#d94f70")
src_lab <- c(tnds = "TNDS", bods_gtfs = "BODS GTFS")

theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title.position = "plot")
map_theme <- theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

col <- function(what, p) paste0(what, "_", p)
nm <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", "(unnamed)", x)
# "Area, zone": the ATCO administrative area a reader recognises, then the
# LSOA/Data Zone code that links the stop to the LSOA report. An analysis
# output from before `area` was added still knits, with the zone alone.
loc_of <- function(d) {
  area <- if ("area" %in% names(d)) d$area else NA_character_
  zone <- ifelse(is.na(d$zone_id), "", d$zone_id)
  out <- ifelse(is.na(area), zone, ifelse(zone == "", area,
                                          paste0(area, ", ", zone)))
  ifelse(out == "", "—", out)
}
upfirst <- function(x) paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
```

```{r intro, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "The LSOA report (`lsoa_disagreement.md`) finds the zones where the choice ",
  "between TNDS and the DfT's BODS GTFS matters most. A zone still hides a lot ",
  "— a bus station's stands, the two sides of a road, a stop code one source ",
  "has replaced — so this report takes the same comparison down to the ",
  "**individual NaPTAN stop**, the finest unit the two sources share.\n\n",
  "Both sources are the same feeds as the LSOA report — `%s` and `%s` — after ",
  "`UK2GTFS::gtfs_deduplicate()`, buses only. Each stop is counted by ",
  "`UK2GTFS::gtfs_stop_frequency()` **twice**:\n\n",
  "- over the LSOA report's %d-day window, **%s to %s**; and\n",
  "- on **%s** alone, the second day of that window.\n\n",
  "A timetable that stops early — a TNDS registration expiring inside the ",
  "window, a BODS calendar cut short — makes the sources disagree over the ",
  "window but not on a day both still cover. Genuinely different timetables ",
  "disagree on any day. Comparing the two periods is what tells those apart.\n\n"),
  basename(g$feeds[["tnds"]]),
  sub(".*GTFS/([0-9]+)/.*", "BODS GTFS \\1", g$feeds[["bods_gtfs"]]),
  wl, format(win$startdate, "%e %B %Y"), format(win$enddate, "%e %B %Y"),
  format(day, "%A %e %B %Y")))
```

The measure is **bus departures at the stop**: every stop-time of every
journey, multiplied by the number of times the journey runs in the period. A
journey that calls at a stop twice (a loop) counts twice there, and every stop
is counted whether or not it is a timing point, because UK2GTFS interpolates
the times of the rest. That is why stop totals do not add up to the LSOA
report's zone totals, which count each journey once per zone.

Each stop with service in either source falls into one of four kinds of
disagreement, or agrees:

- **TNDS only** — departures in TNDS, none at all in BODS GTFS;
- **BODS only** — the reverse;
- **TNDS higher** / **BODS higher** — both serve it, one more often;
- **equal** — the same count in both.

```{r check, results="asis"}
ck <- g$check
same <- ck$mismatch_tnds == 0 && ck$mismatch_bods == 0
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "**Check.** The per-date departures behind the case charts are counted ",
  "separately from `gtfs_stop_frequency()`, from each source's service dates ",
  "in the window. Summed over the window they %s: %s of %s stops differ in ",
  "TNDS and %s in BODS GTFS (totals %s against %s, and %s against %s).\n\n"),
  if (same) "reproduce its counts exactly" else "do **not** reproduce its counts",
  fmt(ck$mismatch_tnds), fmt(ck$stops), fmt(ck$mismatch_bods),
  fmt(ck$total_tnds[["stop_frequency"]]), fmt(ck$total_tnds[["by_date"]]),
  fmt(ck$total_bods[["stop_frequency"]]), fmt(ck$total_bods[["by_date"]])))
```

## The four kinds of disagreement

```{r summary-table, results="asis"}
summ <- rbindlist(lapply(names(periods), function(p) {
  d <- s[get(col("type", p)) != "neither"]
  d[, type := factor(get(col("type", p)), levels = type_lv)]
  out <- d[, list(Stops = .N,
                  TNDS = sum(get(paste0(p, "_tnds"))),
                  BODS = sum(get(paste0(p, "_bods"))),
                  abs_gap = sum(abs(get(col("gap", p))))),
           by = type][order(type)]
  out[, `Share of absolute difference` := pct(abs_gap / sum(abs_gap))]
  out[, Period := periods_short[[p]]]
  out[]
}))
tab <- summ[, list(Period, Kind = as.character(type), Stops = fmt(Stops),
                   `TNDS departures` = fmt(TNDS),
                   `BODS GTFS departures` = fmt(BODS),
                   `Absolute difference` = fmt(abs_gap),
                   `Share of absolute difference`)]
knitr::kable(tab, align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 5)))
```

```{r summary-text, results="asis"}
sw <- summ[Period == "window"]
sd <- summ[Period == "day"]
tot_w <- s[, c(sum(win_tnds), sum(win_bods))]
tot_d <- s[, c(sum(day_tnds), sum(day_bods))]
one_w <- sw[type %in% c("TNDS only", "BODS only"), sum(abs_gap)] / sum(sw$abs_gap)
one_d <- sd[type %in% c("TNDS only", "BODS only"), sum(abs_gap)] / sum(sd$abs_gap)
eq_w <- sw[type == "equal", Stops] / sum(sw$Stops)
eq_d <- sd[type == "equal", Stops] / sum(sd$Stops)
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "Over the window TNDS counts %s bus departures and BODS GTFS %s (%+.1f%%); ",
  "on the single day %s and %s (%+.1f%%). %s of the %s served stops agree ",
  "exactly over the window and %s on the day.\n\n",
  "Stops served by one source only account for **%s** of the absolute ",
  "stop-level difference over the window and %s on the day. The rest is stops ",
  "both sources serve at different frequencies.\n\n"),
  fmt(tot_w[1]), fmt(tot_w[2]), 100 * (tot_w[1] / tot_w[2] - 1),
  fmt(tot_d[1]), fmt(tot_d[2]), 100 * (tot_d[1] / tot_d[2] - 1),
  pct(eq_w), fmt(sum(sw$Stops)), pct(eq_d), pct(one_w), pct(one_d)))
```

## Window against day: an early stop, or a different timetable?

```{r nat-daily, fig.height=4.6}
nd <- as.data.table(g$nat_daily)[, list(n = sum(n)), by = list(date, source)]
nd[, Source := factor(src_lab[source], levels = names(src_cols))]
ggplot(nd, aes(date, n, colour = Source)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = day - 0.5, xmax = day + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey92") +
  annotate("text", x = day, y = Inf, label = "single day", vjust = 1.5,
           size = 3.3, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = src_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",",
                                                 scientific = FALSE),
                     limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%a\n%e") +
  labs(title = "Bus departures at every stop, date by date",
       subtitle = "All stops served by either source", x = NULL,
       y = "Departures") +
  theme_report
```

```{r nat-daily-text, results="asis"}
ndw <- dcast(nd, date ~ source, value.var = "n")
ndw[, ratio := tnds / bods_gtfs]
r0 <- ndw[date == day, ratio]
wk <- ndw[!weekdays(date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday")]
rl <- wk[date == max(date), ratio]
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "On the single day TNDS counts %s the departures BODS GTFS does; on the ",
  "window's last weekday (%s) the ratio is %s. %s\n\n"),
  sprintf("%.3f times", r0), dfmt(max(wk$date)), sprintf("%.3f", rl),
  if (rl < r0 - 0.005) paste0(
    "TNDS loses ground across the window relative to BODS GTFS, which is the ",
    "signature of TNDS registrations expiring inside it.")
  else if (rl > r0 + 0.005) paste0(
    "BODS GTFS loses ground across the window relative to TNDS, which is the ",
    "signature of BODS calendars ending inside it.")
  else "The ratio barely moves, so neither source tails off across the window."))
```

How each stop's kind of disagreement over the window compares with the kind
it shows on the single day. A stop that disagrees over the window but agrees
on the day disagrees only on other dates — an expiry, a cut-short calendar, or
a difference confined to some days of the week. A stop that disagrees the same
way on both is a different timetable.

```{r crosstab, results="asis"}
ct <- s[type_win != "neither"]
ct[, type_day := ifelse(type_day == "neither", "no service on the day", type_day)]
xt <- dcast(ct[, .N, by = list(type_win, type_day)], type_win ~ type_day,
            value.var = "N", fill = 0)
xt <- xt[match(intersect(type_lv, xt$type_win), type_win)]
ord <- c(intersect(type_lv, names(xt)), setdiff(names(xt), c("type_win", type_lv)))
xt <- xt[, c("type_win", ord), with = FALSE]
setnames(xt, "type_win", "Window \\ day")
xt[, (ord) := lapply(.SD, fmt), .SDcols = ord]
knitr::kable(xt, align = c("l", rep("r", length(ord))))
```

```{r crosstab-text, results="asis"}
# The share of each window kind's absolute difference that sits at stops
# which agree exactly on the single day, or show the same kind there
agg <- ct[type_win %in% types, list(
  abs_gap = sum(abs(gap_win)),
  same_kind = sum(abs(gap_win)[type_day == type_win]),
  agree_day = sum(abs(gap_win)[type_day %in% c("equal")])),
  by = type_win]
agg <- agg[match(types, type_win)]
lines <- agg[, sprintf(paste0(
  "- **%s**: %s of the window difference is at stops showing the same kind on ",
  "the day, and %s at stops where the two agree exactly on the day."),
  type_win, pct(same_kind / abs_gap), pct(agree_day / abs_gap))]
cat(lines, sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n")
```

## Stop codes: missing, or filed under a neighbour?

A stop served by only one source may be a stop the other genuinely does not
serve. Or the same buses may be filed under a neighbouring stop code: another
stand at a bus station, the stop across the road, a code one source has
retired. For each one-source stop the test below looks for the nearest stop
within 100 m where the **other** source runs more departures than this one's
does, and compares that surplus with this stop's own count. A surplus within a
third of it is "similar": almost certainly the same buses under two codes.

```{r neighbours, results="asis"}
nbt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(periods), function(p) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c("TNDS only", "BODS only"), function(ty) {
    d <- s[get(col("type", p)) == ty]
    n_own <- if (ty == "TNDS only") d[[paste0(p, "_tnds")]] else d[[paste0(p, "_bods")]]
    dist <- d[[paste0("nb_m_", p)]]
    nbn <- d[[paste0("nb_n_", p)]]
    w30 <- !is.na(dist) & dist <= 30
    w100 <- !is.na(dist)
    # "similar": the neighbour's surplus in the other source is within a
    # third of this stop's count - the same buses rather than another service
    sim <- w100 & !is.na(nbn) & abs(nbn - n_own) <= n_own / 3
    data.table(Period = periods_short[[p]], Kind = ty, Stops = nrow(d),
               `Neighbour ≤ 30 m` = pct(mean(w30)),
               `Neighbour ≤ 100 m` = pct(mean(w100)),
               `… with similar departures` = pct(mean(sim)),
               `Departures at those stops` = pct(sum(n_own[sim]) / sum(n_own)))
  }))
}))
nbt[, Stops := fmt(Stops)]
knitr::kable(nbt, align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 5)))
```

```{r neighbours-text, results="asis"}
w <- s[type_win == "TNDS only" & !is.na(nb_m_win) &
         abs(nb_n_win - win_tnds) <= win_tnds / 3]
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "Over the window %s TNDS-only stops pair up with a neighbour this way, ",
  "carrying %s TNDS departures. Each such pair inflates the one-source count ",
  "at one stop and the frequency difference at the other at the same time. ",
  "The pairs are not reconciled anywhere in this report: they are listed in the ",
  "tables and named in the case notes, because which code is right is a ",
  "question for NaPTAN, not for either timetable.\n\n"),
  fmt(nrow(w)), fmt(sum(w$win_tnds))))
```

## Where the disagreement is

```{r map-prep, eval=has_map}
library(sf)
zmap <- readRDS(map_zones_path)
# A light outline of Great Britain for the stop maps: the zone polygons
# dissolved by country would be ideal but is slow, so the zones are drawn
# with no borders and a pale fill, which reads as the land.
zmap <- st_transform(zmap, 27700)
gb_layer <- geom_sf(data = zmap, fill = "grey95", colour = NA)
stop_map <- function(p, bbox = NULL, min_gap = 1, title = NULL, size_max = 2.2,
                     legend = TRUE) {
  d <- s[get(col("type", p)) %in% types & abs(get(col("gap", p))) >= min_gap]
  if (!is.null(bbox)) d <- d[x >= bbox[1] & y >= bbox[2] & x <= bbox[3] & y <= bbox[4]]
  d[, type := factor(get(col("type", p)), levels = type_lv)]
  d[, mag := abs(get(col("gap", p)))]
  setorder(d, mag)
  base <- if (is.null(bbox)) gb_layer else
    geom_sf(data = st_crop(zmap, st_bbox(c(xmin = bbox[1], ymin = bbox[2],
                                           xmax = bbox[3], ymax = bbox[4]),
                                         crs = st_crs(27700))),
            fill = "grey95", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1)
  ggplot() + base +
    geom_point(data = d, aes(x, y, colour = type, size = mag), alpha = 0.8,
               stroke = 0, show.legend = legend) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = type_cols[types], limits = types, name = NULL,
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = size_max, guide = "none") +
    coord_sf(crs = 27700, datum = NA, expand = FALSE,
             xlim = if (!is.null(bbox)) bbox[c(1, 3)],
             ylim = if (!is.null(bbox)) bbox[c(2, 4)]) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    map_theme
}
cities <- list(
  London = c(503000, 156000, 562000, 201000),
  `West Midlands` = c(388000, 268000, 432000, 305000),
  `Greater Manchester` = c(364000, 382000, 406000, 417000),
  Glasgow = c(240000, 648000, 282000, 683000))
# A stop shows on the national maps if it differs by at least one departure a
# day on average: over the window that is `wl` departures, on the day one.
min_gap <- c(win = wl, day = 1)
```

Every stop that differs by at least one departure a day on average, coloured
by its kind and sized by the difference. Points are drawn smallest first, so
the largest differences sit on top.

```{r map-gb, eval=has_map, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
mw <- stop_map("win", min_gap = min_gap[["win"]], title = upfirst(periods[["win"]]),
               legend = TRUE)
mdy <- stop_map("day", min_gap = min_gap[["day"]], title = upfirst(periods[["day"]]),
                legend = TRUE)
if (has_patchwork) {
  patchwork::wrap_plots(mw, mdy, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = "Stops where TNDS and BODS GTFS disagree",
      subtitle = "At least one departure a day different, on average")
} else {
  print(mw); print(mdy)
}
```

```{r map-cities, eval=has_map && has_patchwork, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, results="asis"}
for (p in names(periods)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n**Close-ups, %s.**\n\n", periods[[p]]))
  pl <- lapply(names(cities), function(nm) {
    stop_map(p, bbox = cities[[nm]], min_gap = min_gap[[p]], title = nm,
             size_max = 3)
  })
  print(patchwork::wrap_plots(pl, ncol = 2, guides = "collect"))
}
```

## The stops that disagree most

```{r ranked-tables, results="asis"}
lists <- as.data.table(g$lists)
for (p in names(periods)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", upfirst(periods[[p]])))
  for (ty in types) {
    ids <- lists[period == p & type == ty][order(rank), stop_id]
    if (!length(ids)) {
      cat(sprintf("\n\n**%s.** No stops.\n\n", ty)); next
    }
    d <- s[match(ids, stop_id)]
    q <- setdiff(names(periods), p)
    nb_col <- paste0("nb_", p)
    nb_txt <- ifelse(is.na(d[[nb_col]]), "",
                     sprintf("%s (%.0f m, %s)", d[[nb_col]], d[[paste0("nb_m_", p)]],
                             fmt(d[[paste0("nb_n_", p)]])))
    tab <- data.frame(
      `#` = seq_along(ids), Stop = d$stop_id,
      Name = substr(d$stop_name, 1, 36), `Area, zone` = loc_of(d),
      TNDS = fmt(d[[paste0(p, "_tnds")]]), `BODS GTFS` = fmt(d[[paste0(p, "_bods")]]),
      Difference = fmt(d[[col("gap", p)]]),
      `Other period` = sprintf("%s / %s", fmt(d[[paste0(q, "_tnds")]]),
                               fmt(d[[paste0(q, "_bods")]])),
      `Nearby stop where the other source runs more (surplus)` = nb_txt,
      check.names = FALSE)
    if (all(nb_txt == "")) tab$`Nearby stop where the other source runs more (surplus)` <- NULL
    cat(sprintf("\n\n**%s.**\n\n", ty))
    cat(knitr::kable(tab, align = c("r", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l")),
        sep = "\n")
  }
}
```

"Other period" gives TNDS / BODS GTFS departures in the period not ranked on.

## The worst cases, route by route

```{r case-intro, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "The top %d stops of each kind in each period. For each one:\n\n",
  "- **Routes.** Every route calling at the stop in either source, in **both ",
  "directions** — so the opposite direction is drawn even where it uses the ",
  "stop across the road. Added to those, every route of the *other* source ",
  "whose stop sequence shares at least half its consecutive stop pairs with ",
  "one of them. Route and trip identifiers are not shared between the sources, ",
  "and route numbers are not reliably shared, but the stop sequence is. ",
  "Matching on ordered pairs keeps the two directions apart, and a source ",
  "that files one stop under another code loses two pairs, not the whole ",
  "route.\n",
  "- **Groups.** Patterns linked that way form directional groups. Within ",
  "each group, journeys at the stop are matched date by date on departure ",
  "time, within **%g minutes** either way: UK2GTFS interpolates the times of ",
  "non-timing points, and a stop that is a timing point in one source may be ",
  "interpolated in the other.\n",
  "- **Charts.** Departures at the stop on every date of the window, which ",
  "shows a source that stops part way through. Departures by hour on the ",
  "single day, which shows whether the difference is the whole day or one ",
  "part of it. A close-up of the stops within 400 m, which shows a ",
  "neighbouring code carrying the missing buses.\n\n",
  "The note at the head of each case is generated from those measurements by ",
  "fixed rules (`case_findings()` in this report). It says what the data ",
  "show, not which source is right.\n\n"),
  g$top_n, tol_min))
```

```{r case-helpers}
# Route numbers from several groups, each listing several, as one short list:
# directional groups chain the routes sharing a corridor, so the same number
# turns up in several of them and in both sources' names
route_list <- function(labels, n = 6) {
  r <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(labels, ",| / "))))
  r <- r[r != ""]
  if (!length(r)) return("(unnamed routes)")
  out <- paste(utils::head(r, n), collapse = ", ")
  if (length(r) > n) out <- paste0(out, sprintf(" and %d more", length(r) - n))
  out
}
# One operator per group: the sources spell the same one differently
# ("Brighton & Hove" / "Brighton & Hove Bus and Coach")
first_operator <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", "—", sub(" / .*$", "", x))
}

case_findings <- function(cs, p) {
  st <- cs$stop
  gp <- as.data.table(cs$groups)
  dl <- as.data.table(cs$daily)
  ty <- st[[col("type", p)]]
  hi <- if (grepl("^TNDS", ty)) "tnds" else "bods_gtfs"
  lo <- setdiff(c("tnds", "bods_gtfs"), hi)
  out <- character(0)

  # 1. a source that stops part way through the window
  last_dep <- function(src) {
    x <- dl[source == src & departures > 0, date]
    if (length(x)) max(x) else as.Date(NA)
  }
  l_hi <- last_dep(hi); l_lo <- last_dep(lo)
  if (!is.na(l_lo) && !is.na(l_hi) && l_lo < l_hi - 1) {
    out <- c(out, sprintf(
      "%s has no departures here after **%s**; %s continues to %s.",
      src_lab[[lo]], dfmt(l_lo), src_lab[[hi]], dfmt(l_hi)))
  }
  # A source whose weekday service changes between the window's two weeks:
  # a registration that expires and is not replaced leaves a trickle rather
  # than nothing (Chelmsford: TNDS falls from 430 a weekday to 30 while BODS
  # GTFS moves to a new timetable), which the rule above cannot see.
  wd <- dl[!weekdays(date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday")]
  wk1 <- wd[date < win$startdate + 7]; wk2 <- wd[date >= win$startdate + 7]
  m1 <- wk1[, list(m = mean(departures)), by = source]
  m2 <- wk2[, list(m = mean(departures)), by = source]
  mm <- merge(m1, m2, by = "source", suffixes = c("1", "2"))
  mm[, change := (m2 - m1) / pmax(m1, m2, 1)]
  if (nrow(mm) && any(abs(mm$change) > 0.25)) {
    first_change <- function(src) {
      r <- mm[source == src]
      x <- wd[source == src & date >= win$startdate + 1]
      x <- x[abs(departures - r$m1) > 0.25 * max(r$m1, r$m2, 1)]
      if (nrow(x)) min(x$date) else as.Date(NA)
    }
    mover <- mm[order(-abs(change))]$source[1]
    cat_src <- function(src) {
      r <- mm[source == src]
      sprintf("%s %s a weekday", src_lab[[src]],
              if (abs(r$change) <= 0.05) sprintf("steady at about %s", fmt(r$m1))
              else sprintf("%s to %s", fmt(r$m1), fmt(r$m2)))
    }
    out <- c(out, sprintf(
      "The two part company between the window's weeks: from **%s**, %s, while %s.",
      dfmt(first_change(mover)), cat_src(mover),
      cat_src(setdiff(c("tnds", "bods_gtfs"), mover))))
  }

  dd <- st$day_tnds - st$day_bods
  if (p == "win" && abs(dd) <= 0.1 * max(st$day_tnds, st$day_bods, 1)) {
    out <- c(out, sprintf(
      "On the single day the two nearly agree (%s against %s), so the window difference comes from other dates.",
      fmt(st$day_tnds), fmt(st$day_bods)))
  }

  # 2. the same buses filed under a neighbouring code
  nb <- st[[paste0("nb_", p)]]
  if (ty %in% c("TNDS only", "BODS only") && !is.na(nb)) {
    own <- st[[paste0(p, if (ty == "TNDS only") "_tnds" else "_bods")]]
    nbn <- st[[paste0("nb_n_", p)]]
    nbname <- s[stop_id == nb, stop_name]
    out <- c(out, sprintf(
      "%s runs more at **%s** (%s) %.0f m away: %s departures more than the other source there, against this stop's %s in %s%s.",
      src_lab[[lo]], nb, nbname[1], st[[paste0("nb_m_", p)]], fmt(nbn),
      fmt(own), src_lab[[hi]],
      if (abs(nbn - own) <= own / 3) ": very likely the same buses under two stop codes" else ""))
  }

  # 3. how the difference divides across route groups
  dcol <- paste0("dep_", p, "_"); mcol <- paste0("matched_", p, "_")
  gp[, dt := get(paste0(dcol, "tnds"))][, db := get(paste0(dcol, "bods_gtfs"))]
  gp[, mt := get(paste0(mcol, "tnds"))]
  gp[, kind := fcase(
    dt > 0 & db == 0 & patterns_bods == 0, "absent_b",
    db > 0 & dt == 0 & patterns_tnds == 0, "absent_t",
    dt > 0 & db == 0, "elsewhere_b",
    db > 0 & dt == 0, "elsewhere_t",
    dt > 0 & db > 0, "both",
    default = "none")]
  gp[, label := ifelse(names_tnds != "" & names_bods != "" & names_tnds != names_bods,
                       paste0(names_tnds, " / ", names_bods),
                       ifelse(names_tnds != "", names_tnds, names_bods))]
  gap_tot <- abs(sum(gp$dt) - sum(gp$db))
  say <- function(k, txt) {
    x <- gp[kind == k][order(-abs(dt - db))]
    if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
    sprintf(txt, route_list(x$label), fmt(sum(abs(x$dt - x$db))))
  }
  out <- c(out,
    say("absent_b", "Only in TNDS, with no route in BODS GTFS sharing their stop sequence: **%s** (%s departures)."),
    say("absent_t", "Only in BODS GTFS, with no route in TNDS sharing their stop sequence: **%s** (%s departures)."),
    say("elsewhere_b", "BODS GTFS has a route with the same stop sequence as **%s** but it does not call at this stop code (%s departures)."),
    say("elsewhere_t", "TNDS has a route with the same stop sequence as **%s** but it does not call at this stop code (%s departures)."))
  both <- gp[kind == "both"]
  if (nrow(both)) {
    mt <- sum(both$mt); ut <- sum(both$dt) - mt; ub <- sum(both$db) - mt
    out <- c(out, sprintf(
      "Routes in both (%s): %s journeys match within %g minutes; %s TNDS and %s BODS GTFS journeys have no counterpart.",
      route_list(both[order(-(dt + db))]$label),
      fmt(mt), tol_min, fmt(ut), fmt(ub)))
  }
  out
}

case_figure <- function(cs, p) {
  st <- cs$stop
  ln <- as.data.table(cs$lines)
  pt <- as.data.table(cs$patterns)
  dl <- as.data.table(cs$daily)
  hr <- as.data.table(cs$hourly)
  nr <- as.data.table(cs$near)

  # Route map: one colour per service (both directions of the same routes),
  # the six busiest named, the rest grey
  svc_runs <- pt[, list(runs = sum(runs),
                        label = paste(unique(na.omit(route_short_name))[1:min(2, uniqueN(na.omit(route_short_name)))],
                                      collapse = "/")),
                 by = service][order(-runs)]
  svc_runs[, key := ifelse(seq_len(.N) <= 6, paste0(seq_len(.N), ". ", nm(label)), "other")]
  pal <- c("#2a78d6", "#d94f70", "#e09a1a", "#2e9e6b", "#7b52c7", "#4c4c4c")
  keys <- svc_runs$key[svc_runs$key != "other"]
  cols <- c(stats::setNames(pal[seq_along(keys)], keys), other = "grey75")
  ln <- merge(ln, pt[, list(node, service, source)], by = "node")
  ln <- merge(ln, svc_runs[, list(service, key)], by = "service")
  ln[, Source := factor(src_lab[source], levels = names(src_cols))]
  ln[, key := factor(key, levels = names(cols))]
  setorder(ln, node, seq)
  ln <- ln[order(key == "other", decreasing = TRUE)]
  lsf <- st_as_sf(ln, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
  lsf <- aggregate(lsf$geometry, by = list(node = lsf$node), FUN = function(g) {
    st_cast(st_combine(g), "LINESTRING")
  })
  lsf <- st_sf(lsf)
  lsf <- merge(lsf, unique(ln[, list(node, key, Source)]), by = "node")
  lsf <- st_transform(lsf, 27700)
  bb <- st_bbox(lsf)
  pad <- max(bb[3] - bb[1], bb[4] - bb[2]) * 0.05 + 300
  bb <- bb + c(-pad, -pad, pad, pad)
  ctx <- st_crop(zmap, bb)
  fp <- data.frame(x = st$x, y = st$y)
  m1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = ctx, fill = "grey96", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_sf(data = lsf, aes(colour = key), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = fp, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 3.2, fill = "black",
               colour = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~Source, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_sf(crs = 27700, datum = NA, expand = FALSE, xlim = bb[c(1, 3)],
             ylim = bb[c(2, 4)]) +
    labs(title = "Routes through the stop, both directions") +
    map_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

  # Close-up: stops within 400 m, coloured by kind in this period
  nr[, type := factor(ifelse(get(col("type", p)) == "neither", "equal",
                             get(col("type", p))), levels = type_lv)]
  nr[, n := pmax(get(paste0(p, "_tnds")), get(paste0(p, "_bods")))]
  lsl <- st_crop(lsf, st_bbox(c(xmin = st$x - 400, ymin = st$y - 400,
                                xmax = st$x + 400, ymax = st$y + 400),
                              crs = st_crs(27700)))
  m2 <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = lsl, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = nr, aes(x, y, colour = type, size = n), alpha = 0.9,
               show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = fp, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 6, colour = "black",
               fill = NA, stroke = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = type_cols, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 6, guide = "none") +
    coord_sf(crs = 27700, datum = NA, expand = FALSE,
             xlim = st$x + c(-400, 400), ylim = st$y + c(-400, 400)) +
    labs(title = "Stops within 400 m") +
    map_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3)))

  dl[, Source := factor(src_lab[source], levels = names(src_cols))]
  c1 <- ggplot(dl, aes(date, departures, colour = Source)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = day - 0.5, xmax = day + 0.5, ymin = -Inf,
             ymax = Inf, fill = "grey92") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = src_cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 days", date_labels = "%e %b") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(title = "Departures per date", subtitle = "shaded: the single day",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_report + theme(legend.position = "none")

  hr <- merge(CJ(source = c("tnds", "bods_gtfs"), hour = 0:27), hr,
              by = c("source", "hour"), all.x = TRUE)
  hr[is.na(departures), departures := 0]
  hr <- hr[hour <= max(23, hr[departures > 0, max(hour, 23)])]
  hr[, Source := factor(src_lab[source], levels = names(src_cols))]
  c2 <- ggplot(hr, aes(hour, departures, fill = Source)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = src_cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 27, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(title = "By hour, single day", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_report + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  layout <- "
AAA
BCD
"
  patchwork::wrap_plots(A = m1, B = m2, C = c1, D = c2, design = layout,
                        heights = c(1.25, 1))
}

group_table <- function(cs, p) {
  gp <- as.data.table(cs$groups)
  dc <- function(src) gp[[paste0("dep_", p, "_", src)]]
  gp[, dt := dc("tnds")][, db := dc("bods_gtfs")]
  gp[, mt := get(paste0("matched_", p, "_tnds"))]
  gp <- gp[dt > 0 | db > 0 | runs_tnds + runs_bods > 0]
  gp <- gp[order(-(abs(dt - db)), -(dt + db))]
  gp <- utils::head(gp, 10)
  data.frame(
    `TNDS route` = ifelse(gp$patterns_tnds == 0, "—", nm(gp$names_tnds)),
    `BODS route` = ifelse(gp$patterns_bods == 0, "—", nm(gp$names_bods)),
    Operator = substr(first_operator(gp$operator), 1, 30),
    `From → to` = substr(sprintf("%s → %s", gp$from, gp$to), 1, 52),
    `TNDS here` = fmt(gp$dt), `BODS here` = fmt(gp$db),
    Matched = fmt(gp$mt),
    `Last date T / B` = sprintf("%s / %s", dfmt(gp$last_tnds), dfmt(gp$last_bods)),
    check.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r cases, eval=has_map && has_patchwork, results="asis", fig.width=11, fig.height=10}
cases <- as.data.table(g$cases)
shown <- character(0)
for (p in names(periods)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### Cases: %s\n\n", periods[[p]]))
  if (p == "day") {
    dc <- cases[period == "day"]
    rep_n <- sum(dc$stop_id %in% cases[period == "win", stop_id])
    cat(sprintf(
      "%d of these %d stops are also among the window's cases, and are not drawn again. %s\n\n",
      rep_n, nrow(dc),
      if (rep_n >= nrow(dc) / 2) paste0(
        "For most of the worst stops, then, what makes them disagree over a ",
        "fortnight is already there on a single ordinary weekday: a different ",
        "timetable, not one cut short.")
      else paste0(
        "Most of the worst stops on the day are not the worst over the window, ",
        "so much of the window's worst disagreement comes from other dates.")))
  }
  for (ty in types) {
    cat(sprintf("\n\n#### %s\n\n", ty))
    ids <- cases[period == p & type == ty][order(rank), stop_id]
    if (!length(ids)) { cat("No stops of this kind.\n\n"); next }
    for (i in seq_along(ids)) {
      id <- ids[i]
      cs <- g$case[[id]]
      st <- s[stop_id == id]
      cat(sprintf("\n\n**%d. %s — `%s`**, %s. TNDS %s, BODS GTFS %s (%s); %s, TNDS %s, BODS GTFS %s.\n\n",
                  i, st$stop_name, id, loc_of(st),
                  fmt(st[[paste0(p, "_tnds")]]), fmt(st[[paste0(p, "_bods")]]),
                  periods_short[[p]],
                  c(win = "over the window", day = "on the day")[[setdiff(names(periods), p)]],
                  fmt(st[[paste0(setdiff(names(periods), p), "_tnds")]]),
                  fmt(st[[paste0(setdiff(names(periods), p), "_bods")]])))
      key <- paste(id)
      if (key %in% shown) {
        cat("Shown in full above.\n\n")
        next
      }
      shown <- c(shown, key)
      if (is.null(cs)) { cat("No routes found for this stop.\n\n"); next }
      f <- case_findings(cs, p)
      if (length(f)) cat(paste0("- ", f), sep = "\n")
      cat("\n\n")
      print(case_figure(cs, p))
      cat("\n\n")
      cat(knitr::kable(group_table(cs, p),
                       align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "l")),
          sep = "\n")
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```

"TNDS here" and "BODS here" are departures at the stop itself in the period. A
route can show zero there and still be drawn: it is the opposite direction, or
the other source's matching route, which calls at a neighbouring stop code
instead. "Matched" counts journeys found in both within the tolerance; "Last
date" is the last date in the window on which the group calls at the stop.
